controls.requirement: Lock producer behavior and seal execution
Fix and verify private case randomness
Bind pre-exposure membership; separate summary release from safe retired-answer publication

attack_cases.attack: Commit exam configuration after its cases can be known
attack_cases.required_behavior: Block the profile/round; preserve ordering evidence.

attack_cases.attack: Serve conflicting policy manifests to different parties
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject disagreement; retain evidence and quarantine affected decisions.

attack_cases.attack: Suppress aborted rounds until a favorable draw occurs
attack_cases.required_behavior: Detect missing or selectively aborted scheduled/dispatched jobs and draws; retain disposition and block unsupported audit claim.

attack_cases.attack: Replace code or data at an unchanged URL after commitment
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject content mismatch before execution.

attack_cases.attack: Change callback, preprocessing or normalization after protected input
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject mutation; no accepted result from changed artifact.

attack_cases.attack: Use candidate identity, nonce retries or arrival order to search for easier cases
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject seed-affecting metadata outside the fixed approved domain.

attack_cases.attack: Select a different beacon round after inspecting the committed event
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject proof/event mismatch; no silent substitute.

attack_cases.attack: Withhold the last private contribution to choose completed randomness
attack_cases.required_behavior: Stop under the qualified failure rule; retain abort; do not exclude contribution to change draw.

attack_cases.attack: Use a public beacon as a supposed secret root with a public generator
attack_cases.required_behavior: Fail active-case confidentiality review; no claim of hidden cases.

attack_cases.attack: Publish a retired root that also derives material for a live pack
attack_cases.required_behavior: Block disclosure; preserve role/pack links.

attack_cases.attack: Candidate reads truth through a mount, metadata token or reference API
attack_cases.required_behavior: Deny access; evidence of any successful path blocks the profile.

attack_cases.attack: Candidate obtains MMS solution expression or latent answer coefficients
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject unauthorized input path; distinguish allowed forcing from answer construction.

attack_cases.attack: Candidate exfiltrates through callbacks, network, logs or output metadata
attack_cases.required_behavior: Block channel or reject output under the disclosure contract; retest.

attack_cases.attack: Next candidate reads prior job state, temporary files or device memory
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject cross-job access; failed isolation blocks use.

attack_cases.attack: Client intake/practice service accesses official cache or seeds
attack_cases.required_behavior: Deny authorization across services; quarantine if exposure occurred.

attack_cases.attack: Root operator copies answer plaintext from its own host
attack_cases.required_behavior: Do not report host secrecy; reject a threat claim covering that actor without a qualified stronger boundary.

attack_cases.attack: A new hotkey submits a revised candidate to an exposed pack
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject new admission based on global pack state, independent of identity.

attack_cases.attack: A committed late-running candidate receives another candidate result
attack_cases.required_behavior: Permit summary release only with required checks and qualified evidence that pending jobs cannot change through it; otherwise hold the affected pack. Influence or bypass invokes incident handling.

attack_cases.attack: Reuse old answers under a renamed supposedly fresh round
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject asset-lineage mismatch; evaluate overlap under the qualified sampling law.

attack_cases.attack: A scheduled time-lock opens before candidate work closes
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject plaintext-release scheduling that can precede the verified retirement condition. Summary release follows its separate approved policy.

attack_cases.attack: Replace predictions/reference bytes while preserving a nominal result ID
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject integrity/provenance mismatch and block finalization.

attack_cases.attack: Trusted signer submits fabricated computation evidence
attack_cases.required_behavior: Require qualified independent integrity evidence; signer identity alone cannot approve it.

attack_cases.attack: Drop expensive failed references or score their candidates zero
attack_cases.required_behavior: Preserve reference failure; no easy-case substitution or candidate physics failure.

attack_cases.attack: Admit unlimited precommitted variants to overwhelm selection precision
attack_cases.required_behavior: Enforce supported field/admission policy; more compute does not authorize a stronger claim.

attack_cases.attack: Import JSON asserting security_approved=true with a fake evidence ref
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject forged authority; editable drafts cannot create qualification.

attack_cases.attack: Suspected leakage affects multiple pending uses of a cached pack
attack_cases.required_behavior: Quarantine all affected pending uses; preserve historical records and route disposition.

attack_cases.attack: Race an answer publication with a late prediction write, new repetition or retry
attack_cases.required_behavior: Atomically reject post-retirement answer-dependent writes; only bound replay/audit survives; no reopened scientific entitlement.

attack_cases.attack: Disclose customer-private cases or sibling active-pack material through a retired archive
attack_cases.required_behavior: Reject publication based on rights and lineage; preserve reason and protected audit route.

attack_cases.attack: Claim a maximum batch size as actual throughput despite low proposal supply or larger evidence requirements
attack_cases.required_behavior: Retain underfilled/failed-group cost and field-dependent evidence; block unsupported operating recommendation.

attack_cases.attack: Exploit accumulated public answer keys, exact overlaps or near-duplicate families to pass future protected cases
attack_cases.required_behavior: Test freshness against held-out cases; block unsupported release/generation profile; any new exclusions require prospective scientific authority.

source_basis.screenshots: User-supplied discussion; recommendations only, no identity or misconduct verification

notes: No seeds, answers or protected physical cases belong in this record.
Registry shape checks do not execute the attack cases.
A runtime must verify qualified references through its owning authority; it must not trust this file as approval.
v0.2 revises the research proposal, not production policy. No intentional fill wait is the default design direction; actual execution remains blocked until qualified.
Eight controls remain mandatory. Price cannot waive security; the optional wait/reuse design must earn its incremental cost and latency.
All attack cases remain unexecuted; static consistency checks confer no security authority.
